messages.subject: Helios licence to Tessandri - getting started
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Good to speak earlier. As discussed, we want to license the Helios LiDAR patents and know-how to Tessandri Instruments in Milan, for the industrial and robotics field only - we keep automotive ADAS for ourselves. Can you get the NDA out to them so we can open up the technical discussions?

Marco Tessandri is their MD; their GC is Giulia Ferretti.

Eleanor

messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Thanks. I attach the mutual NDA for Project Indigo (our codename for this). It carves the discussions and the Helios family as confidential and runs for three years. Happy for you to send it straight to Marco, or we can issue it - let me know.

Elena Marchetti and Tom Gallagher are on the team with me.

Kind regards,
James
